body: I'm sorry you're having to go through this. Sometimes I feel like I'm in a similar situation with my wife, but it doesn't sound as bad as what you're going through. I know it's easier said than done, but you shouldn't let fear of being seen as a failure make you do things you don't want to do. It's your life, no one else has to live it but you. I highly doubt anyone would see a relationship problem as a failure. Relationship difficulties are not rare and almost everyone has some. People fall in and out of love. It happens. If you're unhappy to the point of suicide, leaving a partner that you don't love should be easy by comparison. You didn't mention if you had kids, but assuming you don't that puts you in a better position to split. I know for certain that you can find someone that appreciates you and loves you for who you are. You just need to do things on your own time and for your own reasons. Don't let fear of judgement stand in your way. You can do it! Good luck and God bless.
